contract.title: Autonomous Architect Review & Rework Lifecycle
prohibited_actions: Do not modify PredatorAI product code frontend backend domain application provider or product tests
Do not create consume or modify TASK-0131
Do not modify tracked historical product task or handoff artifacts
Do not weaken Codex execution Scope Guard validator registry Git ingress visible Codex execution ReworkContract validation or Product Owner gate
Do not add another long-running watcher or another generic process launcher
Do not give Architect Product Owner approval DONE task-creation or product-write authority
Do not implement automatic recovery after Codex execution but before review publication
Do not broaden task identifiers beyond existing TASK identifiers and AIDP-INFRA followed by exactly four digits
acceptance_criteria: ArchitectTaskContract and all exact ingress parser tests accept productive AIDP-INFRA followed by exactly four digits while preserving all existing TASK identifier behavior and rejecting every broader identifier shape.

Immutable ArchitectReviewRequest ArchitectFinding ArchitectReviewResult and disposition contracts implement the exact request result identity evidence authority HEAD tree validation provenance and timestamp rules in the approved specification.

PASS has exact request HEAD and tree binding no remediation findings and no rework authority; FAIL has at least one canonical machine-readable finding authorized non-widening scope and validators; BLOCKED grants neither approval nor rework authority.

A headless ArchitectReviewCoordinator reuses ProcessRunner and SubprocessRunner with shell-free argv read-only sandbox unattended ephemeral schema-constrained output timeout bounded capture CLI capability validation and sanitized process identity audit; WindowsVisibleCodexRunner is not its default.

The authoritative Product worktree identity guard binds configured resolved path Git common directory expected branch remote and repository identity and blocks orchestration-execution or architect-contract worktrees from serving as Product lifecycle authority.

One AIDPLifecycleOnce boundary is supervised by the existing AIDPLocalWatcherRuntime and routes READY_FOR_CODEX and REWORK_REQUIRED to the existing Codex path READY_FOR_ARCHITECT to ArchitectReviewCoordinator WAITING_FOR_PRODUCT_OWNER to hard-stop NO_ACTION and unsafe states to BLOCKED.
The existing watcher lock protects both Architect and Codex work and no competing watcher or parallel Product-worktree agent execution is introduced.
Successful Codex review publication atomically and exactly commits the READY task to REVIEW plus deterministic handoffs so no uncommitted relay state can become lifecycle truth.

A validated Architect result is exclusively persisted and read-back verified in Product Git-internal runtime before any lifecycle mutation and a sanitized structured result envelope is then committed to Product Git without stdout stderr prompts secrets or unapproved transient metadata.
Architect PASS projects only ARCHITECT_APPROVED then WAITING_FOR_PRODUCT_OWNER and repeated watcher iterations perform no Architect Codex rework task creation DONE transition or acceptance mutation.

Architect FAIL deterministically produces an iteration-addressed immutable existing ReworkContract after committed FAIL projection with exact task iteration expected HEAD scope canonical findings validators and authorized result timestamp and the existing rework Codex path executes it.

Runtime persistence provides immutable review requests results attempts iteration-safe rework contracts lifecycle events and audit records under the authoritative Product repository Git-internal orchestration runtime.

The loop ledger permits at most three autonomous Codex rework executions and four Architect reviews including initial review; a FAIL requiring Rework 4 blocks with ESCALATION_REQUIRED and cannot execute Codex.
Two consecutive post-rework FAIL results with the same deterministic canonical finding fingerprint block immediately with ESCALATION_REQUIRED without free-text similarity authority.

Unchanged reviewed tree no finding-relevant authorized file change stale HEAD duplicate execution identity review replay iteration jump changed-content duplicate result timeout non-zero exit malformed output schema mismatch scope widening validator widening dirty worktree divergence wrong reviewed commit multiple active tasks and Product Owner authority assertions all fail closed.

Deterministic persisted requests resume before launch; live or unverifiable attempts never duplicate; persisted results are reused without relaunch; committed projections resume remaining deterministic steps; FAIL before rework persistence regenerates exactly the same contract.
A detected crash after Codex execution but before review publication preserves execution evidence blocks with ESCALATION_REQUIRED emits a precise diagnostic and never duplicates Codex execution.

Isolated temporary Git acceptance tests prove PASS FAIL multiple rework limit no-progress Product Owner hard gate worktree identity all specified blocked paths and restart idempotency using Fake ProcessRunner where appropriate.
The full Python test suite and git diff check pass and Scope Guard confirms that only the exact allowed infrastructure source and orchestration test paths changed.
No PredatorAI product functionality product data TASK-0131 Product Owner inference or unrelated refactoring is introduced.
